NAM.note: The AI tool is in the health sector, which this study excludes.

facts.fact: Health Minister Esperance Luvindao said Namibia has introduced AI-powered digital chest X-ray technology for tuberculosis screening and early diagnosis, and that she was screened with it at a World TB Day event in Omusati.

systems.system: AI-aided digital chest X-ray TB screening
systems.owner: Ministry of Health and Social Services

NAM.note: Document does not say the tool was built or hosted in Namibia.
